subject_group: 6.1.10 Vertical/short takeoff and landing air vehicles

versions.text: Criterion: Verify that V/STOL transition/conversion is safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.7.1.8 Transition/Conversion. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, design, test, or configuration documentation.

Standard: The air vehicle is no worse than Level 2 flying qualities during transition and conversion between forward flight and V/STOL configurations, with no performance deficit conditions that are not automatically prevented by the control system or clearly alerted to the pilot during the deceleration post-conversion. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis of all transitions and conversions to evaluate air vehicle capabilities and control margins, to include: a. Single air vehicle operations. b. Formation transitions and conversions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess flying/handling qualities as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Transition/Conversion paragraph, including performance deficit protection, for each combination of air vehicle states, control modes, and environmental conditions, to include: a. Single air vehicle operations. b. Formation transitions and conversions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess flying/handling qualities in MIL-STD-1797, Transition/Conversion paragraph, including performance deficit protection, for selected combinations of air vehicle states, control modes, and environmental conditions, to include: a. Single air vehicle operations. b. Formation transitions and conversions.
